QuestInfo.name: [Dimension Invasion] Across Worlds
QuestInfo.0: Edea wants to talk to you in Heliseum.
QuestInfo.1: Edea told you that the Interdimensional Portal opened, spilling out a torrent of strange new enemies. Investigate the #bInterdimensional Portal#k from the #bDimensional Mirror#k.

0.0: Can anyone hear me? Some kind of strange creatures are swarming Heliseum! They must be from #rMaple World#k! Please, stop them.
0.1: Piston is fighting on the front lines, but he's going to need backup. Please take the #bDimensional Mirror#k to the #bDimension Invasion#k region!

no.0: We desperately need your help. The fight against Magnus has spread us too thin.

1.0: Are you the one that Edea sent? You'll have to do. Take a look at all those creatures out there.

npc.0: Have you talked to Piston yet?
